messages:
rita: quick RFC follow-up: proposing a compact 'escrow + spillback' pattern for active/active residency breaches. keeping it lightweight for staging.

rita: idea summary: when a write would violate residency, proxy writes to an encrypted escrow in-origin region and return 202 + X-Escrow-Id. reads go to fallback region unless tenant is pinned.

omar: good. questions: escrow TTL, delivery guarantees, and operator visibility?

rita: TTL default 3m (configurable, max 10m). delivery uses idempotent replay with escrow sequence numbers; workers mark delivered/quarantined. console shows live escrow list.

devops-lee: ops thresholds? we need alerts before buildup.

rita: alert if pending_escrow_count > 5000 or avg_age_p90 > 90s. auto-throttle when > 20k (start rejecting with 429).

compliance-choi: legal angle: escrow stored encrypted in-origin; cross-region delivery only if residency policy allows. strict-residency tenants must never leave region even escrowed.

rita: agreed. strict tenants get immediate 403 on write attempts if policy blocks, operators get manual remediation flow.

omar: how to avoid cache/traffic spikes on drain?

rita: delivery workers emit warmup events and ramp weight up in 5 steps, 30s apart. rate-limit per-tenant delivery.

ci-bot: deploy: escrow-service v0.1 deployed to staging (sha: a1b2). experiment scheduled tomorrow 09:00 UTC, rollback +6h.

devops-lee: I'll add dashboards and a short on-call playbook.

compliance-choi: I'll review gating and redact rules; require audit fields: tenant_id, escrow_id, residency_flag.

rita: thanks team — I'll open the runbook and post the run id here when ready.
